description: A read-only look across the shop: stale quotes, overdue or failed invoices, tomorrow's visits that are not ready, recap drafts, unanswered customer requests, the one setup step still missing, jobs under the margin floor, double-booked workers, and maintenance that is due. Ranked, best first. Snoozed items are left out. Each item has next_actions. Nothing is sent.
name: agent_checkup

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
